{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds an `interfaces::Block` IPC handle, modifies `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, and fixes a data race occurring across concurrent IPC worker threads.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a data race where concurrent IPC worker calls race on block template members during `submitSolution()`. This stabilizes the mining IPC interface by passing immutable `Block` handles across the process boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies `src/interfaces/mining.h`, `src/node/interfaces.cpp`, and template tests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a data race on `m_block_template` members when concurrent worker threads call `submitSolution()` while reading template getters (#36515). Applying solutions to a copy rather than mutating the template in place protects template integrity for external miners."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to `test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py` and minor helpers in `ipc_util.py` are tests of mining IPC behavior rather than framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member. Tests exercising concurrent template reads and IPC solution submission belong to the mining and IPC areas they cover."
    }
  ],
